'''Daniel Hennequin''' (born 14 December 1961) is a French physicist. His primary research areas include the dynamics of lasers and cold atoms. He is a former member of the board of the [[Société Française de Physique]], and the winner of the 2013  {{interlanguage link|Prix Jean-Perrin|lt=Jean Perrin Prize|fr}} of the French Optical Society.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.unisciel.fr/prix-jean-perrin-de-popularisation-scientifique-pour-kezako-et-quidquam/|title=Prix Jean Perrin de popularisation scientifique…pour KEZAKO et QuidQuam|work=unisciel.fr}}</ref>
